Fixtures here are synthetic (no real machine's serials or IDs) but follow the documented output formats of the real tools: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=... --format=csv,noheader,nounits`, `/proc/meminfo`, `/proc/cpuinfo`, `/etc/os-release`, `lspci -D -mm -nn`, libdrm `amdgpu.ids`, macOS `sysctl`/`vm_stat`/`system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType -json`, Windows PowerShell 5.1 `ConvertTo-Json` (pretty-printed here; the probes use `-Compress`, which differs only in whitespace), `llama-server --version`, `ollama --version` and `docker model version`. AMD sysfs trees are built in t.TempDir() by the tests.
